title: Parts Department Orders and Germany Delays
summary: This topic centers on parts ordering and dealership parts-department interactions, with several examples mentioning repairs delayed while waiting for parts from Germany but most sampled fragments lacking explicit sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say owners are pleased with most parts of the car, though the examples are broad rather than specific to parts service.

negative.summary: The negative review describes a diagnosed issue whose repair is delayed because the needed part has not yet arrived.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention parts being ordered, parts-department referrals, waiting for Germany-sourced parts, or vague dissatisfaction with part quality without a clearly assigned sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are classified as undetermined, which limits confidence in a strong sentiment reading for this topic.
The cluster mixes dealership process comments, repair-status updates, parts availability delays, and product-quality remarks about interior or vehicle parts.
Positive examples are generic statements about liking parts of the car and do not provide much concrete detail about the parts department or ordering experience.
